title: Watch face does not sync from Android Aaps to Watch?
body:
After installing latest AAPS wear 3.3.1.2 on my Samsung G6 Watch (OneUI 6.0, Wear OS 5.0) via Wear2 app...(.I did delete the previous AAPS app on the watch)....

I somehow cannot re-install/send the custom watch face (AAPS Wear tap, load watch face) via my Samsung S22 Ultra (OneUI 6.0, Android 14)?

When I select the desired watchface... it waits a little time then displays the choosen watchface... but on my watch nothing happens?

Rarely the watchfaces I used before having to switch to the Wear installer are still on my watch and working dromen old AAPS version I guess?

Anyone any advice on how to solve this? I want my chosen watch face to appear on my watch?
Might it be related to another issue on github mentioning MTR93600 Watchface not available

comments.body:
> When I select the desired watchface... it waits a little time then displays the choosen watchface... but on my watch nothing happens?

On the watch, did you also select the AAPS Custom watchface?

Thanks for your quick reply! 

I do not think I have/can...not with the watch faces on the AAPS app on my phone and tranfer them from there. See picture one.. something changed here since  uofrade to UI 6.0 on the [watch?](

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2e305858-20c7-46d2-b390-9679a68cfdad)


.. I did select an onder watchface on my Watch , the one I would not like to use , see.pictire 2 from the watch. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dcd40db3-a44d-4de7-af9f-354b06a728de)

Double check you have installed the AAPS wear .apk is of the same AAPS build (and same signing key) as AAPS installed on phone. 

You should be able to activate/select select the AAPS(Custom) watch face. Then go to Wear on the phone to select the desired watchface.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ffb93847-f98b-4ef2-ac2e-9de63bc5c26b)
Thank you, so much! that is what solved it! I specifically need to select the custom watch face.. somehow i was looking for a menu option..or so...
